title: VedAI Clinical Psychiatry AI Assistant
summary: AI-assisted workflows for clinical psychiatry assessment and case review: structured context templates for 80+ clinical scenarios and 12 standardized case workflows.
overview: VedAI was a private platform for AI-assisted clinical psychiatry assessment and case review. My work turned expert clinical reasoning into structured, reusable context for the model, and standardized how new case workflows were set up. Details are shared at a high level under confidentiality.
myRole: As an AI researcher, I designed the structured context templates and worked with clinical experts and engineers to standardize case workflows and the documentation that supported them.

sections.title: What I Worked On
content: Designed structured context templates for 80+ clinical scenarios, so the model received consistent, complete case context.
Worked with clinical experts and engineers to standardize 12 case workflows.
Halved new-scenario setup, from 4 weeks to 2, by reusing the standardized templates and workflows.

sections.title: Scope & Limitations
sections.content: This was a contributor role on a private platform, and the work is not publicly shareable. The summary describes my contributions at a high level rather than reproducing any proprietary content.

outcomes: Built structured context templates covering 80+ clinical scenarios.
Standardized 12 case workflows with clinical experts and engineers.
Cut new-scenario setup time from 4 weeks to 2.
